from pathlib import PurePosixPath

# Login to file_system
password = [p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='file_system'][0]
login = apis.file_system.login(username='nicholas.weber@gmail.com', password=password)
token = login['access_token']

vacations_root = '~/photographs/vacations'
spot_dirs = apis.file_system.show_directory(directory_path=vacations_root, access_token=token, entry_type='directories', recursive=False)
spot_names = [PurePosixPath(p).name for p in spot_dirs]
print('Found vacation spots:', spot_names)

results = []
for spot in spot_names:
    src_dir = f"{vacations_root}/{spot}"
    zip_path = f"{vacations_root}/{spot}.zip"

    # check if zip exists
    zip_check = apis.file_system.file_exists(file_path=zip_path, access_token=token)
    zip_exists = zip_check.get('exists') if isinstance(zip_check, dict) else zip_check
    print(f"\nSpot={spot} src_dir={src_dir} zip_path={zip_path} zip_exists={zip_exists}")

    # compress, delete the directory after compression
    comp = apis.file_system.compress_directory(
        directory_path=src_dir,
        access_token=token,
        compressed_file_path=zip_path,
        delete_directory=True,
        overwrite=bool(zip_exists)
    )
    print('compress response:', comp)

    # verify src_dir deleted
    dir_exists = apis.file_system.directory_exists(directory_path=src_dir, access_token=token)['exists']
    print('src_dir still exists?', dir_exists)
    if dir_exists:
        # fallback delete
        apis.file_system.delete_directory(directory_path=src_dir, access_token=token)
        dir_exists2 = apis.file_system.directory_exists(directory_path=src_dir, access_token=token)['exists']
        print('After fallback delete, exists?', dir_exists2)

    results.append((spot, zip_path, 'done'))

print('\nAll done. results:', results)
